summary: Loads a game dictionary file: builds the file path from the caller-supplied name (or the game-dictionary global when a3 is null), opens a stream, parses each line into quoted key/value tokens, inserts accepted pairs into the sorted string table owned by 'this', closes the stream, sorts the table entries with a comparator, and finally checks whether the locale string is present, reporting it to a diagnostic routine when it is not found. Returns the count of successfully inserted pairs.

operations.description: Initialize the inserted-pair counter v4 to 0.
Guard on a3: when a3 is non-null the path is built from a2 and a3; otherwise from a2 and the aGameDic string.
Format the path string into v7 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using format "%s%s" and components a2 and a3.
Format the path string into v7 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using format "%s%s" and components a2 and the aGameDic string.
Open a stream for the built path by calling sub_534B00, returning a stream handle in v5.
Guard on the opened stream: when v5 is null the function returns -1 immediately.
Early return -1 when the stream could not be opened.
Seed the line buffer: v8[0] is set from byte_5EA438 and the remaining 0x1FC bytes of the buffer are zeroed.
Iterate over every line of the stream while LineInputReader(256) returns true.
Parse the current line buffer into key and value quoted tokens with StringHashTokenParsing(v8, v12, v11).
Guard combining the parse result and insert result: the pair is counted only when parsing succeeds (returns not -1) and SortedStringTableBuilder does not reject it.
Insert the parsed key/value pair into the sorted string table 'this' with SortedStringTableBuilder(this, v12, v11).
Increment the inserted-pair counter v4 when the line yields a successful insert.
Close/dispatch the stream after the read loop with StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch(v5).

Sort the string table via sub_5890AA(this[2], this[1], 16, sub_423830), passing the table's entry-count field (this[1]) and entries-pointer field (this[2]) with a fixed count of 16 and the comparator sub_423830.
Clear the search key buffer v7 by setting its first byte to 0.
Search the sorted string table for the OscLocaleString key with BinarySearchInStringTable(aOscLocaleStrin, v7).
Guard on the locale search: when the key is not found and the assembled key string v7 is non-empty, report it.
Report the non-empty, not-found locale key through sub_588A34(2, v7).
Return the total count of successfully inserted dictionary pairs.
